mentions.name: Fantasy Recipes
mentions.description: This recipe site presents fantasy-themed recipes, each narrated by a different character, inspired by the Necronomnomnom and aimed at people who enjoy D&D.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm writing a recipe site: https://fantasyrecipes.co.uk/

It's aimed at people who enjoy DnD, and I took inspiration from the Necronomnomnom. All the recipes are narrated by a different character.
